component.name: yacr
component.summary: 查看与测量 DWG/DXF 图纸

description.p: yacr is a CAD system written in Rust. It opens local DWG/DXF drawings, shows model space and supported layouts, and provides distance, polyline length, angle and polygon-area measurement.
yacr 是一个用 Rust 编写的 CAD 系统，可打开本地 DWG/DXF 图纸，查看模型空间与受支持 布局，并提供距离、折线长度、角度与多边形面积测量。
This is an early development build with no validated DWG compatibility and no real-GPU acceptance; see the project README before relying on it.
